create_mcp_client: create an MCPClient instance with a model or base_url for inference
add_stdio_mcp_server: add a stdio MCP server to the client with a command and optional arguments
add_sse_mcp_server: add an SSE MCP server to the client with a URL and optional headers
add_http_mcp_server: add a StreamableHTTP MCP server to the client with a URL and optional timeout
run_tool_chat_completion: run a chat completion with available MCP tools and process tool calls
